title: Early Stopping for Large Reasoning Models via Confidence Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2604.04930v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought generation to solve complex problems, but extended reasoning often incurs substantial computational cost and can even degrade performance due to overthinking. A key challenge is determining when the model should stop reasoning and produce the final answer. In this work, we study the confidence of intermediate answers during reasoning and observe two characteristic behaviors: correct reasoning trajectories often reach high-confidence answers early, while incorrect rollouts tend to produce long, unproductive reasoning traces and exhibit less reliable confidence dynamics. Motivated by these observations, we propose CoDE-Stop (Confidence Dynamics Early Stop), an early stopping method that leverages the dynamics of intermediate answer confidence to decide when to terminate reasoning, requiring no additional training and easily integrating into existing models. We evaluate CoDE-Sto

translated_title: 大型推理模型基于置信度动态的早停方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.04930v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大型推理模型依赖长链式思维生成来解决复杂问题，但扩展推理往往带来巨大的计算成本，甚至因过度思考而降低性能。一个关键挑战是确定模型何时应停止推理并生成最终答案。在本研究中，我们考察推理过程中中间答案的置信度，并观察到两种特征行为：正确的推理轨迹通常较早达到高置信度答案，而错误的展开轨迹往往产生冗长且无成效的推理链，并表现出较不可靠的置信度动态。基于这些观察，我们提出了CoDE-Stop（置信度动态早停），一种利用中间答案置信度动态来决定何时终止推理的早停方法，无需额外训练，易于集成到现有模型中。我们评估了CoDE-Stop。
tldr: 本文提出CoDE-Stop，一种无需训练的早停方法，通过监控中间答案的置信度动态来决定大型推理模型何时停止推理，以降低计算成本并避免过度思考导致的性能下降。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoDE-Stop, a training-free early stopping method that monitors confidence dynamics of intermediate answers to decide when large reasoning models should stop, reducing computational cost and avoiding performance degradation from overthinking.
